scope: Wireless channel measurement and selection. Ghidra field knowledge does not count as matching C.

functions.name: BeginWirelessChannelMeasurement
functions.behavior: Seeds selection from MAC halfwords and the shared frame count, resets the best occupancy to 101, and starts channel measurement.
functions.evidence: The ARM body calls 0x02004ac8 and reads the shared counter at 0x02fffc3c. It writes randomState at +0x38, selectedChannel at +6, and minimumOccupancy at +4 before calling 0x020749b8.
functions.uncertainty: Static wireless mechanism; the specific multiplayer UI flow remains unverified.

functions.name: MeasureNextAllowedWirelessChannel
functions.behavior: Finds the next allowed channel and requests asynchronous measurement.
functions.evidence: Exact C calls the allowed-channel mask provider at 0x020115ac, the state/error helpers, and the request helper at 0x02074b04.
functions.uncertainty: Static wireless mechanism; the specific multiplayer UI flow remains unverified.

functions.name: RecordWirelessChannelMeasurement
functions.behavior: Keeps the lowest occupancy and a bitmap of tied channels, then advances measurement.
functions.evidence: Exact C; callback+8/+10 are channel/occupancy and global+4/+12 are best occupancy/bitmap.
functions.uncertainty: Static wireless mechanism; the specific multiplayer UI flow remains unverified.

functions.name: RequestWirelessChannelMeasurement
functions.behavior: Requests a channel measurement through the wireless manager.
functions.evidence: The next-channel routine passes its result callback and channel; this function forwards fixed options 3, 17 and 30 to the core routine at 0x020122d8 and returns its status.
functions.uncertainty: The three fixed option meanings and the specific multiplayer UI flow remain unverified.

functions.name: FinishWirelessChannelSelection
functions.behavior: Selects from the tied bitmap, stores the selected channel, and returns it after setting idle state.
functions.evidence: Exact C calls 0x020737c4 with state 1, reads the bitmap at global +0x0c, calls 0x02074b4c, then writes and reads selectedChannel at +6.
functions.uncertainty: Static wireless mechanism; the specific multiplayer UI flow remains unverified.

functions.name: SelectWirelessChannelFromBitmap
functions.behavior: Selects the only set channel or randomly selects among ties.
functions.evidence: Exact C iterates the sixteen-bit channel bitmap and advances the generator state at global +0x38 with coefficients 69069 and 12345.
functions.uncertainty: Static wireless mechanism; the specific multiplayer UI flow remains unverified.

globals.name: g_wirelessChannelState
globals.evidence: Exact callback, selector, begin and finish C agree on fields at +4, +6, +0x0c and +0x38. Other state fields remain opaque.
